mappings.label: cisco_asa
mappings.rationale: ASA syslog: mostly connection/ACL/NAT messages -> Network Activity (majority class); map-driven activity (Built=Open, Teardown=Close, Deny=Refuse, AAA reject=Fail), action/disposition from message id + action, severity from ASA 0-7. Compromise: VPN/AAA messages forced into 4001; ASA prints 'outbound' Built messages with the foreign (server) side first and the spec language cannot swap conditionally, so src/dst follow the log order; direction_id from inbound/outbound. 5 events without any timestamp stay invalid.

mappings.label: cisco_ios
mappings.rationale: IOS uptime-header syslog (LOGOUT, CONFIG_I, test). Authentication (3002) would be right for LOGOUT but the validator's at_least_one check rejects every 3002 event, so Network Activity Close for tty session exit with actor.user/src ip/session. The log has no wall-clock time (uptime only): time uses sentinel 1e11 ms (1973) as a documented placeholder.

mappings.label: cisco_ios
mappings.rationale: IOS PoE failure (POE disabled until reset) -> Device Config State Change, state Disabled, status Failure, severity from IOS letter/number, device type Switch. Log has no timestamp: time is sentinel 1e11 ms placeholder.

mappings.label: cisco_ios
mappings.rationale: IOS syslog: ACL logs (IPACCESSLOGP/DP/RL), TCP BADAUTH, zone-based FW audit plus generic system messages -> Network Activity (majority of meaningful events); activity/action/disposition map-driven from mnemonic and action; severity from IOS 0-7 or name.

mappings.label: cisco_meraki
mappings.rationale: Meraki MX flows -> Network Activity Traffic; action/disposition from firewall pattern (allow/deny, 1/0 all) and action; src/dst/ports/protocol/mac; time from epoch.

mappings.label: cisco_meraki
mappings.rationale: Meraki ip_flow_start/end -> Network Activity Open/Close; NAT translated fields left unmapped (no OCSF slot).

mappings.label: cisco_meraki
mappings.rationale: Remap: Meraki urls log is an HTTP request record -> HTTP Activity (was forced to Network Activity by the old at_least_one bug); request method drives activity_id (UNKNOWN -> Unknown) and http_request.http_method; URL -> http_request.url.

mappings.label: cisco_meraki
mappings.rationale: Meraki IDS alerts -> Detection Finding; signature as finding uid/analytic uid, message as title, Snort priority 1-4 -> High..Info, decision -> action/disposition. Network context now in evidences[0]: src/dst ip+port, dhost MAC, protocol and ingress/egress direction.

mappings.label: cisco_meraki
mappings.rationale: Meraki AMP security_filtering_file_scanned -> Detection Finding; sha256 as uid, threat name as title, url as desc, action block -> Denied/Blocked, malicious -> High. Network context now in evidences[0]: client ip/port/MAC as src, server ip/port as dst, scanned URL.

mappings.label: cisco_meraki
mappings.rationale: Meraki Air Marshal (rogue SSID / SSID spoofing) -> Detection Finding (WIDS alert); BSSID as finding uid, type as title, disposition Detected, action Observed; radio details unmapped. Network context now in evidences[0]: 802.11 transmitter/receiver MACs as src/dst endpoint.

mappings.label: cisco_meraki
mappings.rationale: Meraki events key=value (wireless association/auth, 802.1X, AnyConnect VPN, DHCP) -> mixed; Authentication would fit majority but validator rejects 3002, so Network Activity with map-driven activity (assoc/auth=Open, disassoc/deauth=Close, failure=Fail) and status, actor.user, client mac/ip, device as dst.

mappings.label: cisco_meraki
mappings.rationale: Meraki free-text events (VPN, port status, blocked RA/DHCP/ARP) -> Network Activity; blocked packets -> Refuse/Denied/Blocked, VPN connect/disconnect -> Open/Close; others Other.

mappings.label: fortinet_fortigate
mappings.rationale: FortiOS key=value, mixed traffic(22)/utm(35)/event(50): network-bearing traffic+utm form the majority -> Network Activity; map-driven activity (accept=Traffic, close/timeout=Close, *-rst=Reset, deny/block=Refuse, ip-conn=Fail), action/disposition from action overridden by utmaction, severity from level then UTM severity, direction from incoming/outgoing, time from eventtime (tz-correct) else parsed date. Compromise: system/VPN/admin events land in 4001 as Other. One event has a broken dstip from the parser.

mappings.label: paloalto_panos
mappings.rationale: PAN-OS SYSTEM CSV (config installed, IKE/route daemon config load) -> Device Config State Change (Log); severity mapped; description as message; event_id as event code. unmapped=false: the PAN parser stores Logstash Timestamp objects in vendor.receive_time/time_generated, which the mapper's Marshal deep-copy for 'unmapped' cannot serialize (Logstash crashes, 0 events); raw_data keeps the full line.

mappings.label: linux_iptables
mappings.rationale: Netfilter LOG kernel lines = per-packet firewall log -> Network Activity/Traffic. action/disposition from log prefix or EdgeOS-style rule suffix (-D drop, -A accept; DROP->Dropped, DENY->Blocked); unprefixed lines unknown. SRC/DST/SPT/DPT as logged (packet src = initiator side). Direction: IN only (INPUT chain)=Inbound, OUT only=Outbound, IN+OUT (forwarded) = Unknown. LEN=packet length -> traffic.bytes, packets=1. One event has only kernel uptime, no wall-clock time -> invalid (no time to map).

mappings.label: sonicwall_firewall
mappings.rationale: SonicOS KV syslog: majority are connection open/close/drop/allow (m=98/537/713/1235/97/14/38/526) -> Network Activity; activity/action/disposition map-driven on message id m (98 Open, 537 Close, drops=Denied/Dropped, 14 web denied=Blocked, IPS 608=Observed). Non-traffic events (admin/config/NTP/IKE/system) share the parser and get activity Other (99) - majority-class compromise. Severity from SonicOS pri (0 emerg..7 debug). src/dst taken as logged (src=initiator); direction from source zone (Untrusted=Inbound, Trusted=Outbound) or rule zone pair. cdur (ms) -> duration; sent/rcvd/spkt/rpkt -> traffic out/in.

mappings.label: watchguard_firebox
mappings.rationale: WatchGuard Firebox proxy traffic logs (ProxyAllow/Deny/Drop/Strip on HTTP/SMTP/POP3/IMAP/FTP/DNS/SIP proxies) -> Network Activity/Traffic. action/disposition from the Allow/Deny disposition token (Deny->Denied/Blocked; ProxyDrop/Strip nuance kept in message). src/dst as logged (client->server); direction from source interface (Trusted/Internal -> Outbound, External -> Inbound). Policy = firewall_rule, proxy action = policy. Severity Informational (syslog PRI on Firebox encodes facility per log type, not severity). File/mail details left in unmapped (no file object in Network Activity).

mappings.label: watchguard_firebox
mappings.rationale: WatchGuard Firebox 'event' (non-traffic) log: cluster/failover, interface, config apply, signature updates, IKE/VPN negotiation failures, IPS/spoof alerts. Majority are device state/status events -> Device Config State Change (5019), activity Log. Compromise: IKE/VPN negotiation events (~25%) would fit Tunnel Activity and their peer IPs/ports stay in unmapped (5019 has no endpoints); the few IPS/spoof alerts would fit Detection Finding. status_id and severity_id are map-driven on WatchGuard msg_id (failures -> Failure/Low, failover/crash/attacks -> Medium, rest Informational); state_id Enabled/Disabled for cluster/interface enable/disable ids. Time from the embedded log timestamp.

mappings.label: juniper_srx
mappings.rationale: Junos structured syslog from SRX: majority are RT_FLOW session create/close/deny, APPTRACK, RT_IDS screens, RT_UTM web/AV, RT_IDP, SECINTEL, PFE firewall -> Network Activity. activity_id map-driven on event_type (CREATE=Open, CLOSE=Close, DENY=Refuse, others Traffic); action/disposition from the explicit action attribute when present (drop->Denied/Dropped, BLOCK(ED)->Denied/Blocked, alarm-without-drop/NONE->Observed/Allowed, PFE A->Allowed) else from event_type. Severity from threat-severity, else syslog PRI severity bits (err->Medium, warning->Low). Compromise: kmd IKE, sshd login, dot1x and daemon messages share the parser -> activity Other with their specifics left in unmapped. source-* = initiator (client), destination-* = responder; direction from source zone (trust/LAN/Inside -> Outbound, untrust/Outside -> Inbound). username often 'N/A' so left unmapped; NAT addresses unmapped (no NAT attribute in OCSF 1.4 network_endpoint).

mappings.label: checkpoint_firewall
mappings.rationale: Check Point syslog (log exporter) mixes firewall connection logs (Accept/Drop/Reject/Block), threat-prevention logs (IPS/AV/Anti-Bot: Detect/Prevent/Block), Remote Access VPN logins and SmartConsole/Web-API audit events. Majority with src/dst = connection/threat -> Network Activity. activity map-driven: CP actions -> Traffic (Reject -> Refuse); audit operations (Log In/Out, Create/Set Object, Publish, Modify Rule) and VPN 'Log In' -> Other (compromise: these would fit Authentication/Entity Management). action/disposition from CP action (Accept->Allowed, Drop->Denied/Dropped, Reject/Block/Prevent->Denied/Blocked, Detect->Observed/Allowed). Severity from CP severity 0-4 -> Informational..Critical. src/s_port = initiator, dst/service = responder port; direction from ifdir; inzone/outzone -> src/dst zone; client_inbound_* = client->gateway (out), client_outbound_* = gateway->client (in). Time from CP epoch 'time', else syslog header. One IPS log carries service=4294967295 (CP placeholder for -1) and is schema-invalid on port range.

mappings.label: checkpoint_firewall
mappings.rationale: Check Point Gaia OS plain syslog from appliance daemons (xpand, cpviewd, confd, HCP_stateAgent): hardware/RAID/config-daemon status messages, no network flow -> Device Config State Change (5019), activity Log, device = reporting appliance (syslog host). Severity from the syslog PRI severity bits (all samples are debug -> Informational). Daemon name/pid -> actor.process; 'message repeated N times' -> count. Time from the syslog header (year inferred by the parser).

mappings.label: netgate_pfsense
mappings.rationale: pf filterlog -> Network Activity/Traffic; pass/block -> action+disposition; tracker=rule uid, rule_number=rule name; syslog PRI -> severity. Direction left Unknown: pfSense in/out is interface-relative, not network-relative.

mappings.label: netgate_pfsense
mappings.rationale: strongSwan charon [CFG] lines are IPsec connection config being loaded/dumped (vici load-conn) -> Device Config State Change/Log on the firewall; key=value config lines kept in unmapped.

mappings.label: netgate_pfsense
mappings.rationale: ISC dhcpd server -> DHCP Activity; activity from DHCPv4 message type or DHCPv6 event (Reply=Ack, Advertise=Offer, Request=Request; housekeeping lines=Other). Client (ip/mac/hostname/duid) as src_endpoint.

mappings.label: netgate_pfsense
mappings.rationale: pfSense OpenVPN server peer handshake -> Tunnel Activity (4014) now that the validator bug is fixed (was Network Activity). 'Peer Connection Initiated' = Open/Success; IV_* peer-info lines = Other (key/value kept in unmapped). Remote VPN client = src_endpoint (inbound to the server), authenticated VPN user = user, protocol_name OpenVPN, severity from syslog PRI.

mappings.label: netgate_pfsense
mappings.rationale: dhcp6c (pfSense as DHCPv6 client) -> DHCP Activity; Sending Release = Release; address added to the firewall interface -> device.ip/interface.

mappings.label: netgate_pfsense
mappings.rationale: unbound query log -> DNS Activity/Query; client ip, qname, qtype, qclass.

mappings.label: netgate_pfsense
mappings.rationale: HAProxy connection/HTTP log -> Network Activity/Traffic with load_balancer (frontend, status code, termination state), backend/server as dst_endpoint; bytes_read = bytes sent to client = traffic.bytes_in. HTTP Activity unusable (validator bug) and one sample is TCP-mode.

mappings.label: netgate_pfsense
mappings.rationale: Generic kernel error line. Event Log Activity (1008) cannot validate (validator at_least_one bug), so Application Error/General Error with severity from syslog PRI (err -> High).

mappings.label: netgate_pfsense
mappings.rationale: pfSense webConfigurator GUI login -> Authentication (3002) now that the validator at_least_one bug is fixed (was Web Resource Access 6004). Every line is a logon attempt (Logon); 'Successful login' = Success/Allowed/Informational, 'authentication error' = Failure/Denied/Low. Login name = user (the subject being authenticated), client IP = src_endpoint, is_remote (GUI over network), service = webConfigurator, script path = http_request.url.path, auth backend (e.g. Local Database Fallback) = status_detail.

mappings.label: oisf_suricata
mappings.rationale: Suricata EVE mixes alert(16)/dns/tls/flow/http/ssh with no strict majority; Network Activity fits every record. is_alert from event_type, action/disposition from alert.action, severity from alert.severity (1=High..3=Low), signature -> firewall_rule; flow counters toserver=out/toclient=in; http->url, tls->tls. DNS query details unmapped (no slot in 4001).

mappings.label: sophos_utm
mappings.rationale: UTM httpproxy (majority) + packetfilter -> Network Activity (HTTP Activity unusable: validator at_least_one bug). action pass/drop/block/warn/'DNS request' -> action+disposition; proxy request/response fields under proxy_http_*; user/domain as actor.

mappings.label: sophos_utm
mappings.rationale: BIND named daemon status lines on UTM. Event Log Activity unusable (validator bug) -> Application Lifecycle/Other with app=named; listen ip/interface on device.

mappings.label: sophos_xg
mappings.rationale: XG Firewall log -> Network Activity; con_event Start/Stop/Interim -> Open/Close/Traffic; log_subtype/status Allowed/Denied -> action+disposition; severity/priority -> severity; zones, interfaces, countries on endpoints; sent=out/received=in; direction Outbound only when dst zone is WAN, else Unknown.

mappings.label: sophos_xg
mappings.rationale: XG Content Filtering (web filter) -> Network Activity with url and proxy_http_* (HTTP Activity unusable: validator at_least_one bug). Allowed/Denied/Warned/Alert -> action+disposition (Warned=Challenge, Alert=Alert); category -> message.

mappings.label: sophos_xg
mappings.rationale: Sophos XG WAF (reverse proxy) -> HTTP Activity (4002) now that the validator bug is fixed (was Network Activity). activity from HTTP method; httpstatus 403 = WAF block (Denied/Blocked). Client sourceip = src, protected server (localip, server name) = dst, inbound. url path/query, method, protocol version, UA, referer -> http_request; status and content type -> http_response/http_status; WAF reason -> status_detail, rule detail (extra) -> message; bytessent (to client) = bytes_in, bytesrcv = bytes_out.

mappings.label: sophos_xg
mappings.rationale: XG ATP (C2/malware callback) -> Detection Finding/Create; eventid = finding uid, threatname = title/analytic; Drop -> Denied/Dropped. Network context now in evidences[0]: src/dst ip+port, protocol (direction unknown), URL.

mappings.label: sophos_xg
mappings.rationale: XG Anti-Spam -> Email Activity/Scan; spamaction Accept/Drop/REJECT/TMPREJECT/DELIVERED -> action+disposition; Outbound* subtype -> Outbound else Unknown; sender/subject/mailid/size -> email (email.to is an array, left unmapped).

mappings.label: sophos_xg
mappings.rationale: XG Sandstorm verdicts -> Detection Finding/Create; sha1 = finding uid (log_id fallback for an empty record), filename = title, reason -> verdict (cached malicious = True Positive) + desc; Denied/Allowed/Pending -> Blocked/Allowed/Delayed. Network context now in evidences[0]: src/dst ip.

mappings.label: sophos_xg
mappings.rationale: XG IPS -> Detection Finding/Create; signature -> finding uid/title/analytic (Rule), classification -> desc; Drop/Detect -> Dropped/Detected; severity from rule_priority (1=High). Network context now in evidences[0]: src/dst ip+port, protocol (direction unknown).

mappings.label: sophos_xg
mappings.rationale: XG Anti-Virus -> Detection Finding/Create; virus = title/analytic, mailid/file/url = finding uid, Virus -> Detected (no explicit action field), Allowed -> Allowed; severity from priority. Network context now in evidences[0]: src/dst ip+port, protocol (direction unknown), URL/domain, user agent.

mappings.label: sophos_xg
mappings.rationale: XG Event log mixes System(7)/Authentication(4)/Admin(2); Event Log Activity and Authentication are unusable (validator at_least_one bug), so Device Config State Change/Log on the firewall with status_id from status, message, user as actor. Compromise for the auth records.

mappings.label: sophos_xg
mappings.rationale: XG System Health (memory/users/interface usage) -> Device Inventory Info/Log for the firewall; metric values left unmapped (no metrics slot).

mappings.label: sophos_xg
mappings.rationale: XG Wireless Protection AP client counts -> Device Inventory Info/Log; AP/SSID/client count left unmapped.

mappings.label: zscaler_zia
mappings.rationale: NSS health syslog: feed/cloud connection lost -> Network Activity/Fail, status Failure, severity from syslog PRI (crit); NSS host = device.ip, target ip/port/feed = dst_endpoint. Unknown alert lines -> Other.

mappings.label: zscaler_zia
mappings.rationale: ZIA firewall NSS -> Network Activity/Traffic; client csip/csport = src, cdip/cdport = dst, Zscaler egress ssip = proxy_endpoint; Allowed/Blocked -> action+disposition; outbound; in/out bytes; client device/os/owner, login as actor.

mappings.label: zscaler_zia
mappings.rationale: ZIA NSS web (proxy) logs -> HTTP Activity (4002) now that the validator bug is fixed (was Network Activity). activity from reqmethod (GET/POST/PUT...); action Allowed/Blocked/Cautioned/Isolated -> action+disposition (Caution=Challenge, Isolate=Isolated); threatseverity bands -> severity; riskscore -> risk_score. Client (cltip/port) = src, origin server (serverip/host) = dst, outbound. Method, UA, version, sizes, code, content type in http_request/http_response; client-side TLS = tls, server-side TLS = proxy_tls. Client Connector device -> device; login/dept -> actor.user. Uploaded file names left unmapped (file.type_id not derivable per event).

mappings.label: zscaler_zia
mappings.rationale: ZIA DNS NSS -> DNS Activity/Traffic (request+response record); reqaction REQ_ALLOW/BLOCK -> action+disposition; client/server ip; query name/type; error -> status_detail.

mappings.label: zscaler_zia
mappings.rationale: ZIA NSS tunnel logs -> Tunnel Activity (4014) now that the validator bug is fixed (was Network Activity). IPSec Phase1/Phase2 records and 'tunnel is up' events = Open ('down' = Close), periodic Tunnel Samples = Other. Customer edge (sourceip/port, location) = src_endpoint, Zscaler ZEN = dst_endpoint; tunnel type (GRE / IPSec IKEv1/2) = protocol_name; rx bytes (received from customer) = bytes_out, tx = bytes_in; tunnel user = user. IKE crypto params left unmapped (no IPsec object in OCSF).

mappings.label: zscaler_zia
mappings.rationale: ZIA admin audit -> Entity Management; action Activate -> Activate, SIGN_OUT -> Other; resource/subcategory = entity; admin = actor (Admin); result -> status. clientip left unmapped: it is the literal 'Unknown' in 2/7 records, which fails ip_t validation.

mappings.label: zscaler_zia
mappings.rationale: ZIA Endpoint DLP -> Data Security Finding/Create; detection system Endpoint; actiontaken -> action+disposition; severity 'High Severity' -> High; rule, dictionaries, doc type, scanned bytes in data_security; item/file; device and user.

mappings.label: zscaler_zia
mappings.rationale: ZIA SaaS security (CASB DLP) -> Data Security Finding/Create; detection system CASB; is_incident -> is_alert; severity map; rule/dictionaries/doc type in data_security; file (type_id only when extension known), S3 bucket -> databucket.

mappings.label: zscaler_zia
mappings.rationale: ZIA SaaS security activity -> API Activity; activity.type Create/Delete -> activity; operation, app, user (is_admin -> Admin/User), src ip, count.

mappings.label: zscaler_zia
mappings.rationale: ZIA sandbox verdict -> Detection Finding/Create; verdict Benign -> Benign/Informational/not alert, other verdicts -> True Positive (Offensive Tools -> Security Risk)/High; threat indicator in desc, sha256 uid_alt. File details unmapped (no file slot in 2004).

mappings.label: zscaler_zia
mappings.rationale: ZIA Email DLP -> Email Activity/Scan; actions Allow/Block -> action+disposition; severity map; sender/subject/message-id -> email; direction not stated by the log -> Unknown. Recipient lists are arrays (not buildable).

mappings.label: paloalto_panos
mappings.rationale: PAN-OS TRAFFIC (high-res ts variant) -> Network Activity; subtype start/end/drop -> Open/Close/Refuse; action -> action/disposition; NAT, geo and PAN internals left in unmapped.

mappings.label: paloalto_panos
mappings.rationale: PAN-OS TRAFFIC -> Network Activity; subtype start/end/drop -> Open/Close/Refuse; action -> action/disposition; NAT, geo and PAN internals left in unmapped.

mappings.label: paloalto_panos
mappings.rationale: PAN-OS THREAT -> Detection Finding (create); PAN severity -> severity_id, action -> action/disposition (alert=Alert, reset=Reset, drop=Dropped); threat_id as title/analytic; finding uid = log sequence number. Network context now in evidences[0]: src/dst ip+port, zones, interfaces, protocol, session id (direction unknown; url_filename not mapped as it holds a filename for file/data subtypes).

mappings.label: paloalto_panos
mappings.rationale: PAN-OS CONFIG (legacy) -> Device Config State Change, like the existing SYSTEM mapping; admin -> actor.user, client (Web/CLI) -> actor.app_name, command -> event_code, result -> status.

mappings.label: paloalto_panos
mappings.rationale: PAN-OS CONFIG -> Device Config State Change, like the existing SYSTEM mapping; admin -> actor.user, client (Web/CLI) -> actor.app_name, command -> event_code, result -> status.

mappings.label: paloalto_panos
mappings.rationale: PAN-OS USERID login/logout -> Authentication (Logon/Logoff); src_user -> user, src_ip -> src_endpoint, data_source (active-directory, vpn-client...) -> service.name.

mappings.label: paloalto_panos
mappings.rationale: PAN-OS GLOBALPROTECT -> Tunnel Activity; event_id drives activity (gateway connect/setup=Open, logout/disconnect=Close, switch-to-ssl=Renew, portal/config/auth stages=Other); status -> status_id; client public IP/host -> src_endpoint, assigned private IP -> tunnel_interface.

mappings.label: paloalto_panos
mappings.rationale: PAN-OS SCTP -> Network Activity (Traffic); SCTP/diameter specifics left in unmapped.

mappings.label: paloalto_panos
mappings.rationale: PAN-OS DECRYPTION -> Network Activity with tls object (version, SNI, cert) and decryption error as status_detail.

mappings.label: paloalto_panos
mappings.rationale: PAN-OS tunnel inspection log -> Network Activity (inspected session start/end); tunnel inspection counters left in unmapped.
